caption: The drawing depicts a large, round pot with a lid and two short, angled handles on either side of its upper body. The pot and its lid are covered in horizontal stripes that alternate in color, primarily consisting of shades of brown, red, orange, green, and cream. The stripes vary in thickness and are irregularly spaced. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations present. The pot is centered in the composition and fully visible, with the lighting highlighting its rounded shape and the texture suggested by the varying tones of the stripes.
title: Jar with Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
